notes.title: The final stretch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope all is good with all of you. It is time for me to rethink the launch date for Goalie Madness. I am now aiming for the end of September, maybe October. Please bear with me while I figure out how to keep my place and my computer. 

I ran out of resources and I am struggling to keep my apartment, forcing me to put my attention elsewhere. I am disabled and in a considerable amount of pain so my options for work are limited. There is nothing that will stop me but this is slowing me down. 

As I balance things out and deal with this latest rent increase, I will find more time to get to work on the final stretch of the game. I can't wait to hit that release button. 

My apologies to all of you for this. I hope you understand.

Best summer wishes to all,
Eric

notes.title: Latest news
notes.notes:
Hi all. Hope everyone is doing well. It’s been too long since I posted anything. A lot is going on, so I will break this up into 3 little snippets: [b]Release date[/b], [b]funding[/b], and some [b]exciting news[/b].

[h2][color=#0099FF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179084/09e2e99bb54e1a9836b30428d3dba00993813836.png[/img] Release Date[/color][/h2]
As you might have noticed, the release date for Goalie Madness has sadly been pushed back to May. I did not want to be one of those games, especially with shifting release dates being a hot topic in the last couple of years. The game is just not ready and it’s mostly because I underestimated the amount of work involved, like integrating some Steam features for example. There’s a first time for everything. Setting up social media and building a website took out a good chunk of my time as well. I just finished building the website: [url=https://gamermoosestudios.ca/]www.gamermoosestudios.ca[/url].

With some fresh advice from Steam, I might push back even more just to be on the safe side. I don’t want to put out a rushed game; no one deserves that.

[h2][color=#0099FF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179084/406aaaff5501663b52a1b83b4595b27d8e0bda5f.png[/img] Funding[/color][/h2]
I finally live in a place I like and I don’t want to lose it. Making sure I can cover all my expenses every month is a big distraction and it keeps me away from the game. I considered running a Kickstarter to help but it seems a bit of an overkill for a small, first-time project like this. I can offer the game in Early Access instead and build it alongside the Steam community. If I could fully dedicate myself to the studio that way, it would solve a lot. It sure would be easier to get things done. 

[h2][color=#0099FF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179084/adb3dc58387a0d8937c5c0210747c57fa8113528.png[/img] Exciting News[/color][/h2]
The few people that have played the game all say the same thing, and that's: 'It needs one thing: [b]1 vs 1 multiplayer[/b]'. I agree. I considered it in the beginning but at the time, decided on a single-player experience for simplicity. It probably will not be part of the initial release but [b]the game will offer multiplayer[/b], at [u]no extra cost[/u]. I can hear all the cheers from here… You are welcome!

[img align="center"]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179084/d030f0d8b77960ee689fe9c77ff937cdc2184607.png[/img]

That’s it.

Best wishes all,
Eric | GamerMoose Studios
